language.title: Choose your language
language.body: SafeRoute shows the app and writes its reports and spoken warnings in this language. You can change it later.
language.age: SafeRoute is for people aged 18 and older.

countries.fromBody: This shows the right hotlines first.
countries.toTitle: Where will you work or travel?
countries.toBody: Optional. Skip it if you do not know yet.

how.title: How SafeRoute helps
how.body: Three things, nothing to set up.

check.title: Check before you say yes
check.body: Paste a job offer, chat or link, or share a screenshot. SafeRoute looks for trafficking and scam warning signs.

explain.title: See why, in your language
explain.body: You get a clear verdict, the evidence behind it and a spoken warning in the language you choose.

warn.title: Warn family and get help
warn.body: Send a warning to people you trust and find official hotlines for the countries you care about.

shield.title: Turn on the screen shield
shield.body: Optional. You can also do this later from the home screen.

sharing.title: Help others: share anonymous scam patterns
sharing.body: When a check looks risky, SafeRoute can share its pattern so other people may get a warning sooner. This is optional.
sharing.p1: No screenshots and no message text. Only a short pattern is kept.
sharing.p2: Names and other personal details are removed first.
sharing.p3: Phone numbers and accounts are kept only as one-way codes that cannot be turned back into the number.
sharing.p4: Shared patterns are deleted after 90 days.
sharing.note: You can change this at any time in Settings.

account.title: Use SafeRoute your way
account.body: Everything works without an account. Your checks stay on this device.
account.note: An account is optional. It saves your history and trusted contacts so you can get them back on a new phone, and it raises your hourly check limit.
